events.name: Cozy Sundays — Summer '26 Session VII
events.description:
Summer is here, and every fortnight we gather again for Cozy Sundays. You know the drill.
house rules
To enter the space, buzz Ambrook and take the stairs. If you have accessibility needs, message a host for elevator access (key fob required)
The buzzer will be muted after 2:30, as it is quite loud. Please come on time to avoid disrupting the quiet work periods, and to ensure you can get in.
Bring snacks or tea to share, or a suggested donation to the snack fund to continue to support cozy sundays <3
The office has rooms, but they are not soundproof. So please refrain from taking calls during this session as there is limited phone booth availability.
Ambrook is a shoes-off office! Wear your best socks :)
Please only RSVP if you can make it and stay the whole time.
schedule
2-2:30p: arrive, quick primer on the session, intros circle
2:30-3:30p: deep work session #1
3:30-3:45: break
3:45-4:45p: deep work session #2
4:45-5:30: demos - sharing ideas, works in progress, and celebrating wins
5:30-6:00: mingle & wrap up
~ optional ~ some of us grab dinner after!
About Cozy Sundays
We exist to support people as they work on the things that they love but struggle to make time for — this place is not for job hunting, catching up on work, sending emails, making sales pitches or networking.
We fiercely protect what makes each session special because the magic only exists when we all buy in together.
Thank you Ambrook for lending us their space. Ambrook is building the financial layer powering American industry. They are hiring across roles in engineering, growth and sales.
If you can't make it this time but are interested in attending a future session 👉 subscribe to the events calendar lu.ma/cozy-sundays
